import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive multi-panel visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_fillna = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for i, disorder in enumerate(sleep_disorder_fillna.unique()):
    mask = sleep_disorder_fillna == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=disorder, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='best')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
top_occupations = occupation_sleep.head(8)
top_occupations.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax2, color=sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(top_occupations)))
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=8)

# 3. Physical Activity vs Stress Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', alpha=0.6, s=40)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress\n(colored by Sleep Quality)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3, label='Sleep Quality')
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. BMI Category Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                     colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(bmi_counts)))
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)

# 5. Heart Rate Distribution by Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df.boxplot(column='Heart Rate', by='Gender', ax=ax5, patch_artist=True)
ax5.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.suptitle('')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Daily Steps vs Sleep Duration
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax6.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Sleep Duration'], 
           c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=40)
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps vs Sleep Duration\n(colored by Age)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(ax6.collections[0], ax=ax6, label='Age')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Age Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax7.hist(df['Age'], bins=20, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 8. Correlation Heatmap of Numeric Variables
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, ax=ax8, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, 
            square=True, linewidths=0.5, annot_kws={'size': 7})
ax8.set_title('Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=8)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
